entities.summary: Kongeparken is a theme park destination in Ålgård, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A strong regional family park with enough rides and themed activity to justify a purposeful detour. This entry is intended for 4–13 travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
